fact: On 9 September 2025 the Ministry of National Education and New Citizenship began 15-day computer and digital-tools training for managers and staff of its central offices, in groups of 20.
title: Digitalisation de l'administration : le ministère forme ses agents aux outils numériques et à la micro-informatique
publisher: Ministère de l'Éducation nationale et Nouvelle Citoyenneté
